description: 20 labelled prompt-style sentences written before the model was run (not tuned to it). An entity counts as recalled when its text no longer appears in the redacted output. Only PERSON, ORG and LOC are scored (the types the NER model is responsible for).

sentences.text: My name is Priya Venkataraman and I live in Chennai.
Can you help me write an email to Dr. Rahul Mehta at Infosys about my project?
Satya Nadella announced the new strategy at Microsoft headquarters in Redmond.
I'm flying from Mumbai to Berlin next week to meet Angela's team at Siemens.
Summarize this complaint filed by Mohammed Al-Farsi against Barclays Bank.
Our CFO, Elena Petrova, moved the Paris office to Lyon.
Tell Sam Altman that OpenAI should visit Nairobi.
Aarav Sharma from Bengaluru scored the highest marks at IIT Bombay.
Draft a recommendation letter for my student Chloe Dubois, who is applying to Stanford University.
My doctor, Dr. Lakshmi Narayanan, at Apollo Hospitals said the results were fine.
John Smith works for Goldman Sachs in New York.
Please translate this message from my grandmother Fatima Khan in Karachi.
Yuki Tanaka and Hiroshi Sato are co-founders of Sony's startup arm in Osaka.
I received a job offer from Deloitte in Hyderabad; recruiter Neha Gupta called yesterday.
Write a birthday poem for my son Arjun, who goes to school in Pune.
The meeting with Carlos Rodriguez from Telefonica is in Madrid on Friday.

Help me reply to Olivia Brown, my manager at Amazon, about the Seattle relocation.
